name: Accordion Plugin – Category Posts, Product FAQs & Load More
author: Akshar Addons

sections.description:
Accordion Plugin – Category Posts, Product FAQs & Load More organizes WordPress posts inside expandable category panels. Visitors can open a category, browse matching posts, and load more content without refreshing the page.

Use it on a blog homepage, landing page, sidebar, or content area. Configure categories, responsive templates, post images, heading colors, and post display settings from a widget, shortcode, Gutenberg block, or Elementor widget.

🚀 Key Features

  • ✅ AJAX-powered loading of WordPress posts and FAQs by category from custom post types.
  • ↔️ Previous/Next AJAX pagination in the free version.
  • 🧩 Responsive category accordion layouts.
  • 🖼️ Post grid and post list display options.
  • 🎨 Custom heading, category, and post title colors.
  • 📱 Multiple widget instances for sidebars and content areas.
  • 🧱 Native Gutenberg block and Elementor widget support.
  • 🔗 Shortcode support for pages, posts, and templates.
  • 🔎 Category selection for focused post content.

🔗 Product Links

Buy Now | Live Demo | Documentation | Support Request

🧩 Shortcode

[postaccordionpanel template="pane_style_2" number_of_post_display="8"]

🎯 Perfect For

  • Blogs with category-based content navigation.
  • News, magazine, and editorial websites.
  • Homepages with expandable post sections.
  • Sidebars and compact content areas.
  • FAQs layout with posts list and load more button

🔧 How It Works

  1. Edit a page or post.
  2. In Gutenberg, add a Shortcode block. In Elementor or a supported page builder, add a shortcode element.
  3. Paste [postaccordionpanel template="pane_style_2" number_of_post_display="8"].
  4. Select categories, choose a responsive template, and configure the display settings.
  5. Publish the page and let visitors load posts with AJAX.

⭐ Premium Features

Upgrade for advanced category accordion plugin controls:

  • ⚡ Load More, Previous/Next, and numeric AJAX pagination buttons.
  • 🧱 Custom post type, tag, and taxonomy support.
  • 🧱 Elementor widget and Gutenberg block controls for premium settings.
  • 🔎 Search posts from each accordion panel.
  • 🎨 Additional templates with list, grid, and hover animation layouts.
  • 🖼️ Controls for image size, post title, excerpt, pagination, and read more link.
  • ↕️ Sort categories and posts by title or ID in ascending or descending order.
  • 👁️ Show or hide post counts, empty categories, dates, comments, and author details.
  • ⭐ Open a selected category by default or add an All panel.
  • 🌳 Hierarchical subcategory accordion support.
  • ↔️ RTL support and adjustable spacing between post items.
  • 🔗 Dynamic multiple shortcode creation for content areas.
  • ↕️ Display FAQs in Elementor using a category-based custom post type list with a Load More button.
sections.installation:
1. Install the accordion plugin from Plugins > Add New, or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the accordion plugin from Plugins > Installed Plugins.
  3. Edit a page or post and add a Gutenberg Shortcode block, Elementor shortcode element, or supported page builder shortcode element.
  4. Paste [postaccordionpanel template="pane_style_2" number_of_post_display="8"], select categories, configure the layout, and publish the page.
sections.faq:
Can I display posts from selected categories?

Yes. Select the categories that should appear in the accordion.

Can I use this accordion in Elementor?

Yes. Add the native Elementor widget and configure its shortcode ID or attributes.

Does it support multiple widgets?

Yes. Multiple widget instances can be placed in different widget areas or pages.

Can I use this plugin as FAQ accordion in Elementor?

Yes, you can use this plugin to display FAQs in Elementor by category using custom post types, with a Load More button.
